name: UTS Digital Access Grant
summary: Once-only grant toward course-related computer hardware, software or internet for low-income UTS students.
key: A $1,000 grant may apply for course-related high-end technical specification equipment.
who: Combined income under $1,200 per fortnight and inadequate savings
Not in the final year of a degree or a degree of 36 credit points or less
how: Provide quotes or receipts and call 02 9514 1177 for a telephone appointment
catches: Hardware support is once only during a degree
A loan may be available for extra funds

evidence.quote: provision of a $1,000 grant may apply to assist students in course-related high-end technical specification equipment
